## Defaults and data

- [ ] Every new default value is labelled "our default" in code, docs and the description, and "unmeasured" where it is.
- [ ] No GPS tracks, rider names, ride dates or server-identifying details in the code, fixtures or this text.
- [ ] Docs that describe this change are updated (help pages through the docs generator, never by hand).

## Review lenses

Correctness, operations, spec, scope, tests, accessibility, simplicity (taps, walls of text, scrolling), docs.
